context: The user shares an ad-hoc auth error body and asks for a review plus a more consistent, developer-friendly shape. The criteria check whether the response critiques the specific weaknesses of the current shape and recommends the skill's unified issues conventions with a concrete before/after.

checklist.name: Critiques opaque numeric code
checklist.description: Identifies that the numeric/opaque `code: 401` and terse `msg` are not developer-friendly or machine-actionable

checklist.name: Critiques missing debug metadata
checklist.description: Notes the absence of a correlationId / debuggability and that there is no path forward for the consumer

checklist.name: Critiques ad-hoc inconsistent shape
checklist.description: Calls out that the shape is ad-hoc and will not generalise consistently across endpoints

checklist.name: Recommends unified issues array
checklist.description: Recommends a unified `issues` array as the consistent shape across all endpoints

checklist.name: Namespaced code, no separate type
checklist.description: Recommends a single descriptive namespaced string code ({domain}.{class}.{reason}) with NO separate `type` field

checklist.name: Includes severity
checklist.description: The recommended shape includes a `severity` field

checklist.name: Message title and detail
checklist.description: The recommended shape carries a human-readable message (title and/or detail)

checklist.name: Concrete before/after
checklist.description: Shows a concrete before/after example, not just prose recommendations
